<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state():
    a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    # green: find N/r extent on row 10 from col 27
    row = a[10]
    cells = [j for j in range(27,64) if row[j] in 'Nnr']
    g = (min(cells),max(cells)) if cells else None
    row = a[10]; dotg = [j for j in range(27,64) if row[j]=='r']
    # yellow: col 10 rows 26..52
    col = [i for i in range(26,53) if a[i][10] in 'Yyr']
    y = (min(col),max(col)) if col else None
    doty = [i for i in range(26,53) if a[i][10]=='r']
    return g, dotg, y, doty

def probe(r,c):
    before = current_frame.ascii
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    a = before.split('\n'); b = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    ch=[]
    for i,(x,yy) in enumerate(zip(a,b)):
        if x!=yy:
            cols=[j for j in range(64) if x[j]!=yy[j]]
            ch.append((i,min(cols),max(cols)))
    ch=[t for t in ch if t[0]!=63]
    print('click(%d,%d) ch:%s state:%s'%(r,c,ch if ch else 'none', state()))

print('start:', state())
probe(21,44)   # expect green grow +3
probe(38,24)   # yellow slot1 missing
probe(43,24)   # yellow slot2 missing
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
